name: Arcane Protection and Greater Arcane Protection do not stack on the same target (#5167)
contract: spell_group 1141 (rev_20260928_60) pairs Arcane Protection's first rank 573343 with Greater Arcane Protection 573348 under SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_FROM_SAME_CASTER (2). CheckSpellGroupStackRules normalizes both casts through SpellInfo::GetFirstRankSpell, which walks any Arcane Protection rank's ChainEntry back to 573343 (spell_ranks first_spell_id), so casting Greater Arcane Protection 573348 on a target that already carries Arcane Protection rank 3 (573345) from the same caster must remove the single-target aura, leaving only the Greater one. Before the fix, no spell_group links these spells, so Unit::AddAura's stacking check finds no shared group and both auras coexist. Greater Arcane Protection's EffectImplicitTargetA[0] is TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID (56, TARGET_CHECK_RAID), so Spell::SelectImplicitAreaTargets ignores the explicit cast target and instead requires Unit::IsInRaidWith(ally) to be true (WorldObjectSpellTargetCheck, Spell.cpp:9243-9251); the scenario groups caster and ally so the area effect actually reaches the ally.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Greater Arcane Protection is TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID; the ally must be in caster's raid to receive it
Cast Arcane Protection rank 3 on the ally
Clear the GCD before the next cast
Cast Greater Arcane Protection on the same ally
Greater Arcane Protection reaches the ally
Greater Arcane Protection replaces Arcane Protection rank 3 instead of stacking
